title: Relative logarithmic differential sheaf and its canonical generators
statement: For arbitrary schemes $X,Y$ with etale log structures $M,N$ and a relative-section log morphism $f:(X,M)\to(Y,N)$ [def-trf-log-ideal-chart-presentation], work on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. The structure ring has sections $\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$ and restrictions by pullback of regular functions. Define $\omega_f$ as a sheaf of modules over this ring [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]: form the free module presheaf on symbols $da$ and $d\log m$, quotient by the least restriction-stable submodule containing the additive and Leibniz relations for $d$, $d\log(mm')=d\log m+d\log m'$, $d\alpha(m)=\alpha(m)d\log m$, and vanishing of $da$ and $d\log m$ from the base on every compatible relative etale diagram; then apply module sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. The canonical sections $da$ and $d\log m$ are the images of their free generators under quotient and sheafification. No fineness, Noetherian or log-smooth hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: ILO X Proposition 1.2, pp.136–138, and XVI Proposition 3.6.3, p.252 (context); logarithmic differentials convention in the assigned strict smooth sequence and Kato section 1, as implemented by ChartLogSmoothDeformationCalculus.
